injuries.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
injuries.detail: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

injuries.name: Ausar Thompson
injuries.detail: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.detail: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.detail: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.detail: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

injuries.name: Cameron Carr
injuries.detail: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.detail: Edey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Sacramento due to left ankle injury management.

injuries.name: Cedric Coward
injuries.detail: Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jose Alvarado
injuries.detail: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Otega Oweh
injuries.detail: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Black
injuries.detail: Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.detail: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid produced 28 points (8-20 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 12-14 FT), 11 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and four turnovers across 36 minutes in Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jabari Walker
injuries.detail: Walker (ankle) exited Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks in the third quarter and did not return, finishing with six points (2-3 FG, 2-3 FT), three rebounds, one assist and one steal across 12 minutes.

injuries.name: Tacko Fall
injuries.detail: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.detail: Murray is questionable to play Sunday against the Grizzlies due to left ankle capsulitis.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.detail: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
